Hence L_t/delta_t tends to 2 when rho<1 and grows as 2t lambda+log2 e+O(2^-t) when rho=1. For one point e is the minority fiber mass in every packet. Adjacent flips have e_S=2 delta^2[1+epsilon(-1)^(j in S)], so mismatch occupies exactly one Fourier half-cube; the common flipped edge contributes zero to influence change.
